Renee M.: Heads-up: edge peering blackhole simulation + SLO burn-rate drill this Thu 2026-06-03 01:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: validate smart-routing fallbacks and burn-rate alerting. Impact: dedicated egress peers in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 only. Hosted API public pool unaffected.

Omar H.: Quick clarity: are we intentionally blackholing a peer or simulating packet loss?

Renee M.: We'll simulate a partial blackhole by injecting 20% packet-drop on one egress peer for 10m, then expand to 50% for another 10m. The smart router should spill traffic to healthy peers and trigger SLO burn-rate alerts.

TelemetryBot: Maintenance created: https://internal/maintenance/2357773333 state: scheduled owner: @Renee M. notify: oncall slack_channel: #eng-sre

Oncall Priya: I'll be on-call. Pre-run checklist: confirm PD mapping to EDGE-PEER-BLACKHOLE-PD, validate routing table convergence < 30s, ensure synthetic probes active.

Renee M.: Rollout + rollback rules:
```
- Phase A (01:00): inject 20% drop on peer-a for 10m, observe 15m
- Phase B (01:30): inject 50% drop on peer-b for 10m, observe 15m
- Auto-rollback: burn-rate alert >= 2x baseline for 5m OR p99 > 2.5s for 3m
- Exclusions: enterprise orgs on critical-whitelist
```

Omar H.: We'll run synthetic cross-region probes during observe windows:
```
./probe --target egress-peer-a --qps 60 --duration 15m
```

Renee M.: Also: enable TRACE=2% sampling if p99 > 1s and capture netstack perf for affected nodes. Prewarm KV prefixes after routing changes.

SRE Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled 1 hour before window.

Oncall Priya: Posting statuses during observe windows only: phaseA started / phaseA OK / phaseB started / phaseB rollback (if any) / finished. Keep thread minimal.

Renee M.: Post-run: we'll attach burn-rate graphs and routing snapshots to the maintenance ticket and propose any adjustments to reroute thresholds. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
